attributes.title = attributes.title ?? '';
attributes.keywords = attributes.keywords ?? '';
attributes.author = attributes.author ?? 'anonymous';
attributes.layout = attributes.layout ?? 'default';
attributes.cache = attributes.cache ?? false;
attributes.ttl = attributes.ttl ?? 0;

inTernary = cond ? a ?? 'x' : b ?? 'y';
aroundTernary = a ?? b ? 'T' : 'F';
withElvis = a ?? b ?: c;
afterElvis = a ?: b ?? c;
member = config.settings.values.first ?? config.settings.defaults.first;
safe = order?.customer?.address?.city ?? 'unknown';
call = getSetting('timeout') ?? 30;
noSpaces = sct.a ?? 2;
argument = foo(a ?? b, c ?? d);
key = {name: args.name ?? 'none', count: args.count ?? 0};
negated = !(a ?? true);
split = a ?? b;
splitLines = a ?? b;
subject =
    variables.messages.notifications.welcome.subjectLineForNewUsers ??
    variables.messages.defaults.subjectLineForEveryone;
label = (settings.labels.primary ?? settings.labels.secondary ?? settings.labels.fallback) & ' (' & count ?? 0 & ')';
